top_signals.title: Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all
top_signals.summary: Investors expect the Fed to pause rate hikes in October, but Kevin Warsh's rejection of traditional communications practices and continued concern about inflation leave the decision uncertain.

top_signals.title: Commission awards 2026 New European Bauhaus prizes for sustainable, inclusive and beautiful projects
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 16 Oct 2026 The European Commission has awarded the New European Bauhaus (NEB) Prizes 2026 to 13 laureates from several EU countries, Ukraine and North Macedonia, as well as Japan and Brazil, which won the international competition of the awards.
